prompt.text:
Implement `buildReadingWorkspace(title, entries)`. `title` must be a non-empty string after trimming, and it must already be trimmed. `entries` must be an array containing only strings; an empty array and empty entry strings are valid. Invalid input throws `TypeError`. Return `{ type: "workspace", navigation: { type: "navigation", label: title }, main: { type: "content", message: "Ready to review.", entries: copiedEntries } }`, preserving entry order and duplicates. Every call must create fresh workspace, navigation, main, and entries objects. Do not mutate or retain the input array; string values may be reused because they are immutable. Export exactly `{ buildReadingWorkspace }`.
